The Forsworn rebellion was a civil war among the kyrian of Bastion, fought between the Ascended loyal to the Archon, and the dark kyrian Forsworn who are disillusioned with the current order. Originally led by the former Paragon of Loyalty Devos, the Forsworn resent the need for kyrian to let go of their former lives on their path to ascension, believing instead that they should embrace their old emotions and burdens. The Forsworn are also in league with the forces of the Jailer, although not all members of the rebellion are aware of this fact. The number of frames per second (abbreviated to FPS) technically describes the rate of video frame update of the whole screen per second, but mostly can impact image transition smoothness. This rate is often described in hertz (Hz), a frequency in cycles per second. Generally, the frames per second of a game does not help if it exceeds the refresh rate of the monitor (i.e. 60 Hz = 60 frames per second refresh on the monitor). In games like World of Warcraft, a lot of pressure is put on trying to keep the rate as high as possible, but is generally considered more important in faster action games like first-person shooters.

Frank Pearce is the former Senior Vice President and Chief Development Officer, and is one of the co-founders of Blizzard Entertainment. Pearce initially worked as a programmer and receptionist at Blizzard, working on various ports. He did some work on Warcraft: Orcs and Humans, but most of his efforts at this time were directed to Blackthorne and Justice League Task Force. He later worked on Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness; as of 2001, Pearce cited Warcraft II as his favorite game. He later led the Warcraft III development team. Freedom for All Creatures is an Alliance-only quest chain in which players rescue and eventually hatch a Sprite Darter Egg. This has caused no end of jealousy from Horde players who want the pet, as the egg is Bind on Pickup. However, as of patch 3.1, Horde players can slay Sprite Darters in Feralas to receive this pet. This chain has a round-about way of offering quests, which is the reason many people do not complete it. For example, one quest ends at Tyrande in Darnassus but the next starts back in Feralas. However the quests themselves are not high in difficulty, so with this guide an Alliance player can easily acquire their Sprite Darter Hatchling.

Frame strata (sometimes called frameStrata) orders each on the screen, affecting how they overlap. These strata divide the z-axis into nine intervals (from back to front): # WORLD (see details) # BACKGROUND # LOW # MEDIUM # HIGH # DIALOG # FULLSCREEN # FULLSCREEN_DIALOG # TOOLTIP Frame levels further divide each strata into smaller intervals, numbered 0-10000. Higher numbers appear above lower ones, but only if they share the same strata.

Fraweth Whiteshield was a Knight of the Silver Hand. He dueled with Timmanrug in the Third War. The pit lord took away an eye but its wing was injured. They met again some years later in the Blasted Lands. The two fought again and the battle was a bloody one: the dwarf attacked the pit lord at the belly with his greataxe and the demon's burning blood burned up the knight skin, after Whiteshield hit at the front knees and Timmanrug responded with his fel warblade. The Free Character Migration, also Free Character Realm Migration, is a free service that allows a character to be transferred from a high-population realm to a low-population realm for free. It is not normally available and is only made available at Blizzard's discretion as a method to manage realm populations. It differs from a paid Character Transfer in that only characters in specified high-population realms will be granted it, and they can only migrate to specified low-population realms.

Freed Souls were obtained when freeing the various souls encountered in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Freeing a soul would also give a stacking % buff called Soul's Blessing to your main stat. In live, the currency is Redeemed Soul.
The Fractured Azerite is found at Covescale Rise in Zuldazar.
Frantic Stewards are stewards located in Bastion. They can be found near the Altered Sentinel.
Freak Slayer's Charms did not make it out of the beta. They were created with Blacksmithing (1).
__NOTOC__ The Freed Expedition Members are either gnomes, humans, worgen, or dwarves located at the Ogre Ruins in Exile's Reach.
Fractured Stonewings are left behind when using the following items: *Guardian Stonewing *Sentinel Stonewing

The Fractured Anima Crystal is obtained after fracturing the three Depleted Crystals at the Renounced Bastille in Maldraxxus during Tainted Cores. It is then used to drain anima from dead creatures in Glutharn's Decay.
Fragile Humility Scrolls are found in the Court of Elation in Bastion.
The Frayed Flesh-Stitched Shoulderguards drop from Marwyn at Icecrown Citadel in Icecrown during Death Rising.
Frazzled Guides are gnomes located at Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound during Not On the Itinerary.
Fraying Covenant Beltss are looted from Forgotten Chests in Revendreth.
A Frayed Fetish is left behind when infusing the Fetish of the Dark Caverns, Fetish of the Deep Dungeons, Fetish of the Hidden Labyrinths, or Fetish of the Gilded Catacombs into the Heart Forge.

Freckles is a horse running about erratically on an islet in the Rockskip Falls in Tiragarde Sound. It can spawn with several different appearances (see below), and its purpose is to give Alliance hunters access to courser appearances which are otherwise only found on NPCs tamable by Horde hunters. __NOTOC__
Freed Illidari are night elves and blood elves located in the Vault of the Wardens during the Demon hunter starting experience.
Three Fragmented Echoes spawn during the creation of the Glowing Runeblade in Maldraxxus during The Blade of the Primus. __NOTOC__
Fracture Chambers is an expansion feature achievement earned for completing any run in the Fracture Chambers wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fractured Faerie Tales is an exploration achievement earned by returning the following lost books in Ardenweald.
Frayed Hunting Cowl drops from The Goreclaw in the Raptor's Maw in Tanaan Jungle.
The Fragment of Oshu'gun is looted from the same-named crystal in .

Fragmented Voidlings are flesh beasts located in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Frazzlecraz Explosives are land mines found inside the Goblin Mine in the Southern Barrens.
The Fraudulent Credentials are sold by the Questionable Trader just past Tazavesh Customs Enforcement in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Frame of the False Margrave is dropped by Kel'Thuzad in the Sanctum of Domination.
Fraternal Fervor drops from Felhounds of Sargeras in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Fractured Rubble drops from Sinstone Rampagers at the Catacombs of Regret in Revendreth. It is also mined from sinstone golems.
Freebooter Captain's Boots are looted from Muck-Covered Shoes.

Freed Farmhands are pandaren located in Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit after Farmhand Freedom. Formerly slaves at the farmstead, they join the Alliance and Horde at Westwind Rest and Eastwind Rest respectively.
Fractured Heat Emitters drop from automa in Zereth Mortis and the Sepulcher of the First Ones and can rarely be contained in Sandworn Chests.
Fragmented Sorrow was never made available. It would provide a small amount of Stygia.
Frayed Leather Laces are looted from Kleia and Pelagos' Disgruntled Gift in the Ember Court.
Fragments of Jaina's Staff are located in the Azure Dragonshrine in End Time. They need to be collected in order to start the Echo of Jaina encounter.
Freebooter Hood is a quest reward from Fairwind's "Friends".
Freebooter Shoulderpads are a quest reward from Fairwind's "Friends".
Freebooter Tunic is a quest reward from Proudmoore's Parley.
Fractal Cypher of the Zereth Overseer drops from The Jailer in Sepulcher of the First Ones on mythic difficulty.
__NOTOC__ Fractal Cypher of the Carcinized Zerethsteed teaches you how to summon the Carcinized Zerethsteed mount. This item is a quest reward from Leading Motives.
Fractured Colossus Core drops from Vigilant Guardian in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Fragmented Essences are oozes summoned by Emulsified Souls in the Etheric Vault in Maldraxxus.
Fragment of the Guardian's Seal drops from the Maiden of Vigilance in the Tomb of Sargeras for Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path.
Freed Sri-La Villagers are pandaren located in the Widow's Wail in the Jade Forest. They are trapped in Widow's Web.
Fragmented Key is looted from a Forgotten Jewelry Box in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Fragments of History is an exploration achievement earned by acquiring the following loose pieces of statuary located around the Dragon Isles for for Emilia Bellocq.

Fragments of Celerity are found in the Primalist Future. Collecting these fragments grants Timewalker's Celerity, giving a 15% bonus to haste and movement speed, as well as decreasing cooldowns for 3 minutes.
Fragments of Vim are found in the Primalist Future. Collecting these fragments grants Timewalker's Vim, giving a 10% bonus to health and 5% bonus to damage dealt for 3 minutes.
Frazzled Poultrid Hen is a poultrid found inside a cave at the Dimensional Falls in Zereth Mortis. She sits guarding the Mistaken Ovoid.
Fragrant Dragonflowers are located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.
Foxigleth is a dracthyr located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Framing a New Perspective is an exploration achievement earned by taking pictures with a the S.E.L.F.I.E. Camera at all of the vistas listed in Thaldraszus.
Fractured Neltharite is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (1); taught by Design: Fractured Neltharite.
Frameless Lens is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (15); taught by Design: Frameless Lens.
__NOTOC__ Fractured Glass is a crafting reagent obtained from Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting by Prospecting ore.
